summary: Full end-to-end UI walk-through of Poker Academy (frontend-only, no backend). Verified: onboarding (3 screens, level selection, Inizia), tab Studio -> lezione L01 -> Vai al quiz, Quiz L01 (numeric + option questions, quiz-check/quiz-next, risultato quiz), Simulatore setup (mode-rated/hands-10/comp-realistic/start-session), Tavolo (table-screen, cards visible, action-fold/action-call/action-check, size-33%/50%/75%/100%/allin), verdict-sheet + verdict-continue, range-read-modal + range-skip, next-hand loop, session interruption at score < 50 -> report-screen -> report-done, Profilo (theme-dark/light/system, verdetto immediato/endOfHand, timer, open-glossary, reset-progress + reset-confirm), Glossario con glossary-search. Fixed a real i18n bug: SectionLabel was rendering multi-part children as an array-joined string producing 'DOMANDA ,1' and 'STACK, (BB)'. Now shows 'DOMANDA 1' and 'STACK (BB)'. Deprecated packages detected: TouchableMixin deprecation warning surfaced from a legacy Touchable* component; recommend migrating to Pressable. Also react-native-svg on web logs several 'Unknown event handler property onResponder*' warnings from src/viz/charts.tsx.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED. String(children).toUpperCase() produced comma-joined output when children was a JSX array. Visible as 'DOMANDA ,1' in quiz header and 'STACK, (BB)' in sim setup. Replaced with React.Children.toArray(children).map(String).join('').
'Parti da 100 punti, Conta la decisione, non il piatto vinto.' has uppercase 'C' mid-sentence after a comma. Cosmetic i18n typo (should be 'conta').

With no completed rated session, stats-screen shows only the empty banner and no sub-tab bar (Dashboard/Leak/Le tue stat/Concetti/Posizione). Consider always rendering the tab bar with per-tab empty states, or make it clear that sub-tabs unlock after first session. Also 'Sessione interrotta: punteggio sotto 50' cases don't populate stats, which may confuse users.

issues: Action bar Call/Raise buttons overlap the on-screen console-error overlay ('6 - Unknown event handler property...') in dev, which could hide taps on mobile if it ever surfaces in production.

react_native_issues.issue: Multiple 'Unknown event handler property onResponderTerminate/Grant/Move/Release/TerminationRequest/StartShouldSetResponder' console errors when rendering Svg <Circle>/<Path> in the report/charts. Non-fatal but pollutes logs and produces an in-app red dev-error toast. Reference: /app/frontend/src/viz/charts.tsx:139. Consider dropping responder props on web or using a react-native-svg version compatible with RN Web, or gating Pressable-wrapping only to native.
Console warning 'TouchableMixin is deprecated. Please use Pressable.' emitted during a play session. Some Touchable* legacy component is still in the tree - please migrate to Pressable.

action_items: Review the corrected SectionLabel rendering (already applied) and audit other places using String(children) on JSX nodes.
Fix i18n typo 'Conta' -> 'conta' in sim setup helper text.
Decide UX for stats sub-tabs when there is no session data (currently invisible).
Silence/fix react-native-svg 'onResponder*' unknown event handler warnings on web (src/viz/charts.tsx).
Migrate remaining TouchableWithoutFeedback / TouchableOpacity usages (if any) to Pressable to remove deprecation warning.
Consider not aborting a rated session at <50 without a clearer message; the report says 'Sessione interrotta' but the CTA/flow is otherwise the same.
critical_code_review_comments: src/ui/components.tsx SectionLabel used String(children).toUpperCase() - unsafe when children is an array (produced ',' from Array.toString). Fixed.
app/(tabs)/sim.tsx line 72 passes SectionLabel children as {it.sim.stack} (bb) which relied on the buggy behavior - now renders cleanly.
seed_data_creation: None. App is fully offline / AsyncStorage-based.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is Expo web at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Storage resets between browser automation sessions, so always re-run onboarding (3x onboarding-next with level-* in between). Rated session ends automatically when score drops below 50; use hands-10 for fastest path to report. In loop handle order: range-read-modal (range-skip) -> verdict-sheet (verdict-continue) -> next-hand -> action-check/call/fold.
rca_of_issue: SectionLabel bug RCA: React.ReactNode can be an array; String(array) invokes Array.prototype.toString which joins with ','. For '<SectionLabel>Domanda {index + 1}</SectionLabel>', children became ['Domanda ', 1] -> 'Domanda ,1'. Same for '{it.sim.stack} (bb)'. Fix: normalize children via React.Children.toArray(...).map(String).join('') before uppercasing.
